11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1215|2de92970.name: Alchemist Mallory
1215|2de92970.text: Good day, sir. I'd shake your hand, but as you see, I'm in the middle of something. May I be of assistance?

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings, $c. I can teach you skills and techniques.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

85-complete.name: Billy Maclure
85-complete.text:
You lost a what?  Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
85-complete.title: Lost Necklace

86-accept.name: Billy Maclure
86-accept.text:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
86-accept.title: Pie for Billy

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

97920-progress.name: Lee Brown
97920-progress.text: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
97920-progress.title: Camping 101: Fishing
